mechanism: Horizon-aware training-only probabilistic stacking/convex aggregation as an adaptive selector alternative, rather than selecting only one noisy inner winner.
why_new: Initial capped hard selectors lost current leader on355matched cases. This is a different selection mechanism, not another fixed mixture weight or a retuned rejected component.
proper_objective: Minimize inner empirical CRPS of learned convex predictive mixture, using history-only chronological validation. Then evaluate the entire procedure on untouched outer outcomes under unchanged canonical main score.
mathematical_basis: For mixture F=sum w_i F_i: CRPS(F,y)=sum w_i E|X_i-y|-.5sum w_i w_j E|X_i-X_j|. The simplex includes single-model vertices; this only guarantees inner optimum no worse than a vertex for the same predictive distributions and numerical precision, not improved outer performance.
